text:
elaine: Uploaded a quick Figma frame for the trace detail header — WIP. Question: where should the correlation breadcrumb live and how should the download/export CTA behave? https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/trace-header (frame: Correlation + Export)

sam: Left-of-title feels kinda cramped to me. Under the title as a secondary row keeps title centering intact and reads better on mobile.

miguel: Implementation note: putting it under the title avoids layout shifts when the trace title wraps. downside is extra vertical space, but we can compress line-height.

elaine: For copy/copyability: we should make correlation IDs copyable and keyboard-focusable. Proposed pattern: short hash + copy icon button with `aria-label=\"Copy correlation ID\"`.

kate: a11y: yes to tabbable copy. ensure icon has visible focus ring and meets contrast (3:1) against its container. Tooltips need to be accessible via keyboard and announced by screen readers (use role=\"tooltip\" + aria-describedby).

sam: Microcopy question: primary CTA label — `Download trace` or `Export`? Also formats: JSON default, CSV option? Maybe default download as JSON since that's most useful for debugging.

elaine: I prefer `Download trace` (clearer). Have a primary button for default (JSON) + small chevron for dropdown formats (CSV, flattened CSV, HAR?). Keep primary simple.

miguel: Backend side: JSON for full nested trace, CSV for flattened spans table. For very large traces (>10k spans) we'll stream and return a download link; UX should show streaming progress.

kate: a11y nit: dropdown menu button needs `aria-haspopup=\"menu\"` and `aria-expanded` toggled. Icon-only buttons must have accessible labels or aria-labels.

sam: Copy label ideas: breadcrumb text currently `Corr ID` — maybe too terse. `Correlation` is clearer but long. Could show `Corr` visually and full `Correlation ID` in aria-label.

elaine: That sounds good. Visual: `Corr` + hash (shortened) + copy icon. `aria-label=\"Correlation ID: <full-hash>, press to copy\"` on the copy button.

miguel: UX question: clicking breadcrumb should open request explorer or copy permalink? I think click -> navigate, separate copy icon for copying the permalink. Alt-click is brittle on mobile.

sam: Agree. Click to open, explicit copy icon to copy permalink. Also add a small permalink icon to indicate link behavior.

elaine: Final asks from design side before I update Figma:
1) Breadcrumb under title (compact row)
2) Copy button tabbable and with `aria-label` + visible focus
3) Primary CTA text `Download trace` with dropdown for formats
4) Show spinner/progress and toast for streamed exports for big traces

kate: :thumbsup: a11y ok if all the aria/focus/contrast items are implemented.

ui-bot: Accessibility scan: flagged 1 issue in uploaded frame - icon contrast on dark header. Report: /reports/1968456789

miguel: I'll prototype the dropdown and streaming progress indicator this afternoon and ping when branch is up.

sam: I'll take copy edits and edge-case text (e.g., when trace is huge, show `Download will be prepared, we'll email a link` copy). Thanks!

elaine: Thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma in ~30m and tag for final review.
